dct_description_sm: Compiled from the most recent Surveys in the Hydrographic Office of the Admiralty to 1884 ; ...under the Superintendence of Captain W.J.L. Wharton, R.N., Hydrographer.
Relief shown by spot heights and hachures; depths by soundings.
Soundings in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows drainage, low water areas, small islands, settlements, coastal relief, railways, some roads.
